source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1952, p. 5 ("Rural council results: Newtownards, Comber division"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("Rural council nominations: Newtownards")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes in the page text of BNL 6 June 1952 p. 5 ('Newtownards - Comber division - Captain Bennett, 460; not elected, Hugh Murphy, 247; W. M'Greeghan, 154'); full names from the nominations (block image of BNL 21 May 1952 p. 10)

note: Triennial election of the eighteen electoral divisions of Newtownards (North Down) rural district, one member each. Comber was the only contested division (three candidates), polled Thursday 5 June 1952; fifteen members were returned unopposed and in Greyabbey and Kircubbin, where no one was nominated, the retiring councillors were declared re-elected. Only contest in the district. Names as nominated: Captain William Bennett, J.P., Mr. Hugh Murphy and Mr. William M'Greeghan.
